senses.gloss: , a fictitious word made up of each third letter in <he>מנא̇ מנא̇ תקל̇ ופר̇סין̇</he> (<cite ref="Daniel 5:25">Dan. V, 25</cite>).
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 22a:10">Snh. 22ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4:2">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite> <he>ממתו״ס וכ׳</he> the inscription on the wall was so arranged as to form words composed of its every first, every second and every third letter respectively.
